title: Typing and need an emoji? Open them in 1 second! 😀⚡ #Shorts
description:
Want to add an emoji while typing, without leaving your keyboard? Open the emoji panel instantly! 🙌

⌨️ Windows: Win + . (period) or Win + ;
🍎 Mac: Ctrl + Cmd + Space (on newer MacBooks you can also press the Fn / 🌐 key)

Tip: it works in most apps where you can type text, like chats, notes and browsers.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
